service.description: An organization's scorecard basis in effect (period days, minimum sample, due-date basis, each with its built-in default), each measure's weight, target and floor with its source, the response rules in effect and starting later, the policy's dated rows and whether the user may change them. Requires a purchasing permission (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization that is not the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A dated change of an organization's scorecard basis: periodDays (1 to 730), minimumSample (1 to 1000) and dueDateBasisEnumId (ScorecardDueDateBasis); the row in effect ends where the new one starts, now by default, and fields not given carry over. Each field is audit-logged with the reason. Requires PURCHASE_POLICY_EDIT; refuses a change without a reason, an invalid value or a start in the past (POLICY_INVALID) and a stale expectedFromDate (POLICY_CHANGED).

A dated change of one measure's weight (0 to 100; 0 leaves it out), target and floor (the values where its score is 100 and 0) for an organization: on-time delivery, quality acceptance and RFQ response are rates in percent, higher better; price variance the billed difference in percent, lower better. No formula of its own. Requires PURCHASE_POLICY_EDIT; refuses an unknown measure, a value out of range or a target on the floor's side (CRITERION_INVALID) and a change without a reason (POLICY_INVALID).

A response rule of an organization: a scored evaluation below scoreBelow, or an active supplier risk at or above riskSeverityEnumId, draws effectEnumId (ScorecardEffect: a warning, a warning with review, or a block of new RFQs and purchase orders, which the buying policy's supplier check applies). With scorecardActionId the rule ends and its next version starts with the changes, or with end Y it only ends. An evaluation with Insufficient data draws no response. Requires PURCHASE_POLICY_EDIT; refuses a rule with neither band, an unknown effect or severity, a score outside 0 to 100 (ACTION_INVALID), another organization's or an ended rule (ACTION_UNAVAILABLE) and a change without a reason (POLICY_INVALID).

Evaluate an organization's suppliers over a period (the policy's days to now by default): each supplier given in supplierPartyIds (or supplierPartyId), else every supplier with a receipt in the period, gets an evaluation of its own (evaluate#OneSupplierScorecard) in its own transaction, and a result row: the evaluation, its result (Scored or Insufficient data), score and response, or the reason it failed while the others go on. A retry with the same operationKey answers the first result. Requires SUPPLIER_SCORECARD_EDIT; refuses an organization that is not the user's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a period that ends before it starts or is over two years (PERIOD_INVALID).

One supplier's evaluation for evaluate#SupplierScorecard: on-time delivery from each receipt's due date (the line's first acknowledged date, else its required date, by the policy's basis), quality from the received quantity less what was rejected and what its inspections disposed as scrap, rework or return to supplier, price variance from billed against ordered prices, and RFQ response from the invitations sent, each with its evidence, numerator and denominator; fewer eligible receipts than the policy's minimum sample is Insufficient data, and a scored evaluation draws the response of the rules its score is below. A recalculation of the same period names the evaluation it follows, which stays. Requires SUPPLIER_SCORECARD_EDIT; refuses a supplier the organization may not work with (SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE).

A risk an organization keeps about a supplier: new (severity, category and its evidence, with an owner, response, the evaluation it came from and its dates), changed (supplierRiskId, audit-logged with the reason) or ended (end Y). An active risk at or above a response rule's severity draws its effect on new RFQs and purchase orders. Requires SUPPLIER_PROFILE_EDIT; refuses an unknown severity or category, no evidence, an end before the start or a change without a reason (RISK_INVALID), a supplier the organization may not work with (SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE) and another organization's risk (RISK_UNAVAILABLE).
